rationale: C12 is the strongest template because it uses the same 1954 statutory quotation and the same complete drafting sequence: quote section 4731(g), recite the Treasury Secretary's post-hearing finding and immediate public-interest effectiveness, and proclaim that finding. The child principally adapts C12 from one named drug to six. C01 and C02 are also very close plural-drug precedents, but they quote the superseded Internal Revenue Code provision rather than the exact provision used by the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas section 4731 (g) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 provides in part as follows: Opiate. The word "opiate"...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas section 4731 (g) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 provides in part as follows: Opiate. The word "opiate"...
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces C12's specific statutory foundation and substantially the same quoted definition.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that each of the following-named drugs has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that the following named drug has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.explanation: This is nearly verbatim language, altered mainly to accommodate a list of six drugs instead of one.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found that each of the aforementioned drugs has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found that the aforementioned drug has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.explanation: The operative clause closely follows C12's language and machinery, with only singular-to-plural adaptation.
